short: Size dependence of microstructure of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricat
title: Size dependence of microstructure of AlSi10Mg alloy fabricated by selective laser melting

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: SLM is used for thin walls and lattice struts, so a sub-millimetre feature must be known to behave like the bulk block it is designed from. How the microstructure and hardness of SLM AlSi10Mg change as the built feature shrinks below a millimetre has not been measured systematically.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/need), h2 (HYP/gap), h3 (HYP/hypothesis), h4 (DES/base_system), h5 (DES/variable_sweep), h7 (PRC/forming)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Every width shows the same stacked melt-pool structure, pools about 150 um high and 300 um wide; the 0.27 mm plate is barely one pool wide and has a wavy, powder-decorated surface. Elongated alpha-Al grains grow with <001> along the build direction, and the {001}, {011} and {111} area fractions (about 20, 15 and 8%) do not change with plate width.
states.detail: Absorbed: h8 (STR/microstructure/shape), h9 (STR/microstructure/orientation), h10 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), h11 (STR/defect/extended), h12 (STR/microstructure/distribution), h13 (STR/phase/fraction)

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Hardness falls slightly with plate width, from about 112 Hv at 10 mm to about 107 Hv at 0.28 mm. A thin plate is reheated more by the neighbouring tracks and cools more slowly overall, so Si precipitates out of the supersaturated alpha-Al during the build and the low-angle boundaries recover
states.detail: Absorbed: h14 (PRP/value), h15 (MEC/pathway). Premises: SLM AlSi10Mg annealed at elevated temperature develops the same intragranular Si morphology

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Texture and grain size are set by the melt pool and are size-independent, but the Si precipitation state and the low-angle boundary density, and with them the hardness, depend on the built width

nodes.head: At the melt-pool centres the Si particles form strings along the cell walls in the wide plate and are scattered through the cell interiors in the 0.27 mm plate
nodes.solves: In wide plates the Si particles line the cell boundaries; below about 1 mm they are increasingly found inside the columnar alpha-Al cells
